assets.shortDescription: Enhance your post-production workflow with Adobe After Effects.
assets.description: Default plugin (by Loupedeck) for the most recent version of Adobe After Effects. The actions used in this profie are divided into 4 workspaces. The first workspace is dedicated to most used or favorite actions. In the Effects & Animation workspace, it is possible to trigger favorite effects and add them to a layer with the press of a button. Also keyframes can be managed here. The color workspace allows access to all Lumetri adjustments so that e.g. Exposure or a Vignette can be adjusted with a dial. In the 3D workspace, you can rotate, scale, position in X, Y and Z direction, adjust Camera or Light settings or add 3D effects with a button.

assets.author: insideGen
assets.shortDescription: Control Windows audio from your Loupedeck: volume adjusment, mute/unmute command, default device management, peak meter.
assets.description:
This plugin allows you to adjust and mute/unmute the volume of render and capture devices and display peak meter on each. As well as audio applications.

It also allows you to set default communication and multimedia devices and input/output devices for each application.

More information on Github [Loupedeck-AudioControl-OpenPlugin](https://https://github.com/insideGen/Loupedeck-AudioControl-OpenPlugin).

assets.author: Loupedeck
assets.shortDescription: Edit, record and mix audio in Adobe Audition.
assets.description: This default plugin and plugin profile made by Loupedeck works with the most recent version of Adobe Audition. The default profile includes six different workspaces, that will help in editing, recording and mixing the project. Switching between different types of editing windows is made easy and this profile also offers a separate workspace for mixer actions.

assets.author: Aximmetry Technologies
assets.shortDescription: Change cameras, adjust any property, or select any control board button of your Aximmetry scene from Loupedeck.
assets.description:
Provides integration with the controller system of Aximmetry.

**Allows controlling**

- camera and camera path changes
- any properties of your Flow Graph
- any control board buttons of your scene.

**Two-way communication**: gives visual feedback on the Loupedeck device of

- the current state of your buttons
- the current value of your properties if assigned to a dial

even if you change them from within Aximmetry. **Note that restart of Loupedeck Software and Aximmetry might be required for plugins to connect**

assets.author: BirdDog
assets.shortDescription: The BirdDog Loupedeck plugin is the perfect solution for professionals in the streaming and broadcasting industry.

assets.author: Simon Stuart
assets.shortDescription: This Adobe Lightroom CC Profile provides fundamental controls for the non-Classic version of Lightroom… without the need for any Plugins.
assets.description:
Overview

The Adobe Lightroom CC Plugin provides fundamental controls for the non-Classic version of Lightroom… without the need for any Plugins.
Controls are broken up into key photography operations:
- Image Review - For navigating your images, applying ratings and flags, as well as copying/pasting edit settings across one or more images instantly.
- Editing - A hub, providing control for: Image Rotation, Cropping, Guided Upright, Optics, Histogram, Light, Colour, Detail, Effects, Geometry, Preset Browser, and Masking
- Masking - Total control over masking, without the need to interact with the controls panels. This includes Additive, Subtractive, and Intersectional Masking controls! And yes, you can control the Brush Sizes and Feathering with the LoupeDeck as well!
- Colour - Key control over the Colour Grading aspects of your images.
- Healing - Literally every control you need to rapidly apply Healing Brushes to your images. And yes, you can control the Brush Sizes and Feathering with the LoupeDeck as well!
- Stacking/Merging - Controls for grouping Images into Stacks (particularly useful for Bracketed Exposures), as well as controls to quickly produce HDR Merges (Composites)
With such a vast range of inputs carefully mapped to the LoupeDeck’s input controls, you can speed up your photography workflows massively.
Pro Tip: paired with a graphics tablet (such as a Wacom Intuos Pro), you will not need to touch your mouse from the moment you open Adobe Lightroom CC, to the moment you finish editing for the day.

Info about myself

I am a life-long systems architect and engineer - specialising in automation - across virtually every industry from video games to military and aerospace (including guidance and control systems - my work goes into space!).
Outside of work, my hobbies are diverse… from inline skating (teaching freestyle slalom skating to kids and adults alike) to motorcycles, microelectronics, photography, videography, and producing “edutainment” content for YouTube and Instagram.

When you download the package, please install the additional AppleScripts using the Loupedeck Mac Application tool. You can download the [AppleScripts here](https://ldmarket.blob.core.windows.net/packages/profile5/QLab/AppleScripts.zip).

The names of the AppleScript correspond to the Loupedeck action.  

Currently the rotary dials are not set.  You can use them for midi control, volume control, and/or other functions as you prefer.

There are additional icons in the [icons folder pack](https://ldmarket.blob.core.windows.net/packages/profile5/QLab/Icons%20Backup.zip) that have not been assigned. As well as other scripts and shortcuts that have not been added to a specific layout, but are in the stored actions area of this profile.

Everyoneâ€™s preferences are different, feel free to arrange these however you wish.

This profile was put together by ProjectileObjects (https://projectileobjects.com/) in between making a profile for VIDVOX, the makers of VDMX (https://vidvox.net/).

Thank you to LoupeDeck for provided a controller.

Note: Some of these AppleScripts use keystroke or key codes.  You may need to change your accessibility preferences to give permissions for these scripts to work correctly.
